name: acolyte
lore:
The Acolyte is a creature defined by devotion, thriving in the hushed sanctity of stone cathedrals or the verdant silence of sacred groves. They are the gardeners of the soul, existing where the mundane world brushes against the divine. Their behavior is a study in rhythmic piety; they move to the tolling of bronze bells and the scent of burning myrrh, their hands often calloused by prayer beads or stained by holy oils.

In the social ecology of the realms, they serve as vital conduits, bridging the gap between mortal desperation and celestial whim. They are rarely solitary, usually found within communal hierarchies where silence is a virtue and service is the only currency. To observe an Acolyte is to see a soul tethered to a higher power, their every gesture a choreographed fragment of an eternal liturgy.
